title: Update Level rank labels and apply per-level increasing coin cost (Level 1 = 50, Level 2 = 100, +50 per level up to 50)

requirements.text: Update the Level rank labels shown in the app to exactly use this 5-rank list (in this order) for every Level: "Noob", "Beginner 📈", "Advanced Student 💪🏻", "Pro Student 🔥", "Sigma Student 🗿" (i.e., remove the 🫠 emoji from the Noob rank everywhere and ensure consistent spelling/casing across UI and backend-derived display text).

quotes:
1st lv You want the ranks list to show:
Noob
Beginner 📈
Advanced Student 💪🏻
Pro Student 🔥
Sigma Student 🗿. cost 50 next lv 2 You want the ranks list to show:
Noob
Beginner 📈
Advanced Student 💪🏻
Pro Student 🔥
Sigma Student 🗿 cost 100 and till 50 it increases 50

acceptanceCriteria: Wherever the app displays the rank list (including any Ranks UI and Level UI), the ranks appear exactly as: Noob; Beginner 📈; Advanced Student 💪🏻; Pro Student 🔥; Sigma Student 🗿.
The Profile page level tile and any Level status UI no longer displays "Noob 🫠"; it displays "Noob" instead.
Any backend-provided Level stage display text uses "Noob" (not "Noob 🫠") for Level 1 Noob and for any other Level’s Noob stage.

requirements.text: Revise the Level upgrade coin-cost rules end-to-end so the required coin cost depends on the Level number: all paid upgrades within Level 1 cost 50 coins; all paid upgrades within Level 2 cost 100 coins; and for each subsequent Level up to Level 50 the paid upgrade cost increases by 50 coins per Level (i.e., paidUpgradeCost(level) = level * 50). Keep the initial stage (Level 1 - Noob) free (0 coins), keep the rule that Level number stays the same across its 5 ranks before incrementing, and keep the rule that users can only purchase the immediate next stage (no skipping).

quotes: Sigma Student 🗿. cost 50 next lv 2 ... Sigma Student 🗿 cost 100 and till 50 it increases 50

acceptanceCriteria: Backend `getCurrentAndNextLevelStage()` (or equivalent existing Level status method) returns `nextStage.requiredCoins` that matches: Level 1 upgrades = 50; Level 2 upgrades = 100; Level 3 upgrades = 150; ...; Level 50 upgrades = 2500 (for any paid upgrade within that Level).

Backend purchase/upgrade method enforces: Level 1 - Noob is free and cannot be “purchased”; only the immediate next stage can be purchased; the coin amount deducted equals the required cost for the next stage’s Level number; and max level remains Level 50 - Sigma Student 🗿.

Frontend displays the next upgrade cost using the backend-provided value and does not hard-code 50/100; upgrading at Level 2 correctly shows 100 coins, and upgrading at Level 3 correctly shows 150 coins.

Attempting to upgrade without enough coins fails with an English user-facing error (via existing error mapping/toast behavior), and the user’s coin balance and level status remain unchanged after the failed attempt.

requirements.text: Ensure existing users with previously stored Level stage data continue to work after changing the Noob label and pricing rules, without breaking Level status fetching or purchase flow; normalize/handle any legacy stored Noob rank values (e.g., "Noob 🫠") so users do not get stuck or see inconsistent labels.
acceptanceCriteria: For a user whose stored level stage rank value is the legacy string "Noob 🫠", the backend returns Level status with rank "Noob" and a correctly formatted display text (e.g., "Level 1 - Noob").
Existing users can still call the Level status method and purchase the next stage successfully under the new pricing rules.
No backend traps occur solely due to legacy level rank strings existing in persisted state.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in `backend/main.mo` (no additional backend services).
Only introduce `backend/migration.mo` if a state upgrade is strictly required; prefer backward-compatible normalization when possible.

Do not edit frontend files under `frontend/src/components/ui`, `frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts`, `frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx`, `frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts`, or `frontend/src/main.tsx`.
Use English for any user-facing text.
nonGoals: Adding new ranks beyond the 5 specified ranks.
Changing the rule that Level number stays the same across the 5 ranks before incrementing to the next Level.
Allowing users to skip stages or buy non-immediate stages.
